reports.targetOfTheWeek: Requirements analysis, architecture design of CleanBG (AI Background Remover & Studio), evaluation of client-side vs. server-side AI model inference, and initial project scaffolding with Vite and TypeScript.

tasks.task: Requirement gathering for CleanBG, comparative benchmarking of background removal models (RMBG-1.4, BiRefNet, MODNet), and analyzing client-side WebAssembly viability.
Setup of modern web development environment using Vite, TypeScript, and HTML5 Canvas APIs; structured modular workspace directories (processing, ui, styles).
Prototyping client-side model loading using ONNX Runtime Web (onnxruntime-web) and evaluating hardware-accelerated execution providers (WASM, WebGL, WebGPU).
Building the foundational UI shell: drag-and-drop file upload zone, dropzone pulse animations, and local image preview pipeline using FileReader and Object URLs.
Implementation of HTML5 Canvas rendering engine for handling high-resolution images, aspect-ratio scaling, and pixel-grid rendering.
Integration of Web Worker infrastructure to offload model loading and inference from the main browser thread to prevent UI freezing.
Code review of Week 1 milestone, memory profiling for large uploaded images, and documenting the system architecture in design.md.

reports.learningOutcomes: Gained comprehensive understanding of client-side machine learning deployment using ONNX Runtime Web, WebAssembly constraints in browser sandboxes, multi-threaded Web Worker architecture, and high-performance HTML5 Canvas rendering pipelines.
reports.futureWorkPlan: Implement the complete pre-processing pipeline (image normalization, tensor transformations) and execute the first full inference cycle using the RMBG-1.4 model.

reports.targetOfTheWeek: Implementation of image pre-processing pipeline, tensor generation, executing neural inference in Web Worker, and constructing raw segmentation masks.

tasks.task: Designing the image pre-processing pipeline: bilinear resizing of input images to 1024x1024 tensor format while preserving luminance profiles.
Implementing RGB channel normalization (mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]) into contiguous Float32Array tensor structures.
Executing neural network forward pass in Web Worker using RMBG-1.4 ONNX weights and benchmarking inference latency across CPU and WebGL backends.
Post-processing output probability maps (sigmoid activation extraction) to construct binary and grayscale alpha masks.
Developing mask upscaling algorithms to map the 1024x1024 segmentation mask back onto original high-resolution image coordinates.
Implementing canvas alpha channel blending to produce transparent cutout PNGs with pixel-accurate edge clipping.
Testing inference pipeline across diverse portrait, product, animal, and graphic images to benchmark boundary detection accuracy.

reports.learningOutcomes: Mastered computer vision data pre-processing, multi-dimensional tensor representations, sigmoid probability extraction from raw neural outputs, and bicubic interpolation for mask scaling.
reports.futureWorkPlan: Develop edge refinement controls (feathering, smoothness, edge contrast) and an interactive Split-View slider for real-time before/after comparison.

reports.targetOfTheWeek: Developing edge refinement algorithms (smoothing, feathering, edge contrast, edge shift) and building the interactive Split-View before/after comparison slider.

tasks.task: Implementing mathematical morphology on binary masks: morphological dilation and erosion for the Shift Edge parameter to remove background fringes.
Developing Gaussian feathering and edge blur shaders/canvas filters to produce natural soft transitions along hair, fur, and intricate boundaries.
Implementing edge contrast enhancement algorithms to sharpen object boundaries without introducing halo artifacts.
Designing and coding the interactive Split-View comparison slider with pointer tracking and real-time divider positioning.
Implementing responsive dual-canvas rendering for synchronized zoom, pan, and split clipping between original and cutout states.
Developing keyboard shortcuts (Space to toggle views, Ctrl+Z/Y for undo/redo, bracket keys for brush resize) for power user ergonomics.
Conducting user experience testing of edge adjustment controls and optimizing canvas redrawing cycles with requestAnimationFrame.

reports.learningOutcomes: Learned practical mathematical morphology, 2D convolution for spatial filtering and feathering, coordinated canvas clipping techniques, and rendering loop optimization using requestAnimationFrame.
reports.futureWorkPlan: Construct a manual retouch brush engine with Erase, Restore, Clean, and Magic Wand capabilities with smooth continuous strokes.

reports.targetOfTheWeek: Constructing interactive retouch brush engine, implementing continuous stroke interpolation, flood fill / magic wand, and history stack management.

tasks.task: Developing the canvas brush interaction framework with dynamic cursor radius display and pointer event tracking.
Implementing linear interpolation between consecutive pointer events to eliminate gaps or dotted trails during rapid brush movement.
Implementing Erase mode (destructive alpha zeroing) and Restore mode (retrieving original RGBA pixels from raw image buffer).
Developing the Clean tool with hard edge suppression to instantly eliminate background halos around intricate contours.
Developing the Magic Wand algorithm using seed-point color threshold flood fill in CIELAB color space for contiguous region removal.
Implementing multi-level Undo/Redo history stack with memory-efficient Uint8ClampedArray mask snapshot caching.
Stress testing retouch operations with 4K resolution images, verifying zero memory leaks and instantaneous response latency.

reports.learningOutcomes: Deepened expertise in low-level pixel buffer manipulation (ImageData), real-time vector interpolation, color distance formulas in CIELAB space, and bounded snapshot memory management.
reports.futureWorkPlan: Integrate the Full Studio image suite (Filerobot), custom color adjustments, filter presets, solid and custom backdrops, and multi-format export.

reports.targetOfTheWeek: Full Studio image editing integration, color adjustments, filter presets, solid and custom backdrop replacement, and multi-format export pipeline.

tasks.task: Integrating Filerobot Image Editor as the embedded Full Studio suite for advanced editing, cropping, and annotation.
Customizing Filerobot styling to align seamlessly with CleanBG's modern light theme, tab icons, and custom header controls.
Implementing the Backdrop replacement module: solid color pickers, curated gradient presets, and custom background image upload.
Developing custom color adjustment controls: Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Warmth, and Vignette via Canvas 2D filters.
Implementing artistic filter presets (Studio Warm, Cool Minimal, Dramatic Noir, High Key, Cyber Glow) with real-time preview thumbnails.
Developing the multi-format Export engine with format selector (PNG transparent, JPG with background, WebP lossless) and DPI scaling.
Implementing batch download ZIP bundling and copy-to-clipboard functionality using the modern Async Clipboard API.

reports.learningOutcomes: Acquired skills in integrating third-party complex UI libraries, canvas compositing modes (globalCompositeOperation), color matrix filters, and browser-based file packaging.
reports.futureWorkPlan: Optimize memory consumption, implement server-side fallback on Vercel Edge, deploy to production, and finalize documentation.

reports.targetOfTheWeek: Performance optimization, Vercel cloud deployment, edge API fallback, end-to-end QA, final documentation, and live production release.

tasks.task: Profiling memory and rendering bottlenecks; fixing canvas memory spikes by setting savingPixelRatio: 1 and preventing trapped page scrollbars.
Designing and deploying Vercel serverless API routes (/api/remove-bg) with on-demand model download and processing fallback.
Implementing automated responsive layout adjustments for desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports with 100vh viewport locking.
Comprehensive end-to-end testing with browser automation covering upload, retouch, full studio sync, and export workflows.

Final production deployment to Vercel at https://cleanbg-ai-studio.vercel.app, GitHub repository documentation finalization (https://github.com/Mohitsharma-2007/CLEANBG.git), and preparation of technical presentation for faculty review.

reports.learningOutcomes: Mastered production cloud deployment on Vercel, serverless function optimization, CI/CD automated deployment, cross-browser compatibility testing, and comprehensive project reporting.
reports.futureWorkPlan: Project completed successfully and deployed live to production. Preparation of the 40-page NTCC Final Dissertation Report and viva presentation.
